# Cisco %FAC-SEV-MNEMONIC codes OUTSIDE the syslog tag position. Read by
# test/syslogRealLines.test.js (same "# expect:" format as real-captured.txt).
# receivedAt for every line is 2026-09-24T02:00:00Z.
#
# Origin: the blueeye end-to-end run of 2026-09-24 (real agent + real server,
# snmpsim Cisco 3750). These shapes came out `syslog.raw` there, because the
# classifier only looked for the mnemonic in the TAG. The first two are the
# exact lines from that run's findings; the "logger" lines were captured off
# the wire from util-linux logger 2.39.3 (Ubuntu 24.04, plain Node dgram socket
# on 127.0.0.1, byte-exact) with the command above each.
#
# ---- IOS with `logging origin-id hostname`: seq, HOSTNAME, *stamp, mnemonic ----
# expect: format=rfc3164 facility=23 severity=3 host=sw-core-1 tag=%LINK-3-UPDOWN time=2026-09-24T08:21:50.123Z eventType=link.down ifname=GigabitEthernet1/0/11
<187>52: sw-core-1: *Sep 24 08:21:50.123: %LINK-3-UPDOWN: Interface GigabitEthernet1/0/11, changed state to down
# ---- RFC 5424 from a switch: APP-NAME in the tag, mnemonic opens the MSG -------
# expect: format=rfc5424 facility=23 severity=3 host=sw-core-1 tag=switch eventType=link.down ifname=GigabitEthernet1/0/11
<187>1 2026-09-24T08:21:50.9Z sw-core-1 switch - - - %LINK-3-UPDOWN: Interface GigabitEthernet1/0/11, changed state to down
# RFC 5424 with a NIL APP-NAME
# expect: format=rfc5424 host=sw-core-1 tag=null eventType=link.down ifname=GigabitEthernet1/0/11
<187>1 2026-09-24T08:21:50.9Z sw-core-1 - - - - %LINK-3-UPDOWN: Interface GigabitEthernet1/0/11, changed state to down
